source.title: Secondary and Senior School Curriculum for the Academic Session 2025-26 (Circular Acad-14/2025)
source.notes: Official circular confirming release of the 2025-26 curriculum; the detailed curriculum document is published at https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2026.html. Unit and practical wording in curriculum topics below is described at chapter/component-name granularity and is marked proposed_pending_verification on experiment mappings until a reviewer checks the subject PDF directly.

topics.label: Class XI: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
topics.syllabusReference: Class XI Chemistry, unit 'Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry' (mole concept, concentration, stoichiometry)

topics.label: Class XI: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
topics.syllabusReference: Class XI Chemistry, unit 'Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure' (VSEPR theory, molecular shape)

topics.label: Class XI: Equilibrium
topics.syllabusReference: Class XI Chemistry, unit 'Equilibrium' (chemical equilibrium, ionic equilibrium, pH, indicators)

topics.label: Class XII: Solutions
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry, unit 'Solutions' (concentration of solutions, solubility)

topics.label: Class XII: Electrochemistry
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry, unit 'Electrochemistry' (galvanic cells, electrode potential, Nernst equation)

topics.label: Class XII: Chemical Kinetics
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry, unit 'Chemical Kinetics' (rate of reaction, factors affecting rates)

topics.label: Chemistry practical: solution preparation and laboratory techniques
topics.syllabusReference: Chemistry practical components (Classes XI-XII): basic laboratory techniques and preparation of solutions

topics.label: Chemistry practical: volumetric analysis
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry practical components: volumetric analysis (acid-base titrations and related exercises)

topics.label: Chemistry practical: chromatography
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry practical components: chromatography-based separation experiments

topics.label: Chemistry practical: chemical kinetics experiments
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry practical components: experiments studying rate of reaction

topics.label: Chemistry practical: qualitative salt analysis
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry practical components: qualitative analysis of salts and identification of ions

topics.label: Chemistry practical: electrochemistry experiments
topics.syllabusReference: Class XII Chemistry practical components: electrochemistry experiments
